sections.heading: tyBindSettingsModifier
sections.content: ThetyBindSettingsmodifier can be placed on atyBindhelper object, to control the settings of PhysX Binds created by atyBindhelper in a tyActor setup.

sections.heading: Bind Settings
sections.content: The settings within the bind settings control group correspond to all the same settings found in a normalPhysX Bindoperator. Please refer to thePhysX Bindoperator docs for more info pertaining to each setting.

sections.heading: Display
sections.content:
Show icon: controls whether the underlyingtyBindhelper’s icon will be draw in the viewport.Show gizmos: controls whether the linear/twist/swing gizmos will be drawn in the viewport.Show connections: controls whether a line between object A and B will be drawn in the viewport.

Show icon: controls whether the underlyingtyBindhelper’s icon will be draw in the viewport.

Show gizmos: controls whether the linear/twist/swing gizmos will be drawn in the viewport.

Show connections: controls whether a line between object A and B will be drawn in the viewport.
